# BLO-39898 — POSIX-quote the env-guard hook command, and keep `GUARD_RE` matching it

Changed files:

- `src/server/env-guard.ts` — in `SETTINGS_MERGE_SCRIPT`, `cmd` is now
  `node '<guard>'` with any literal `'` in the path escaped as `'\''`, instead of
  the bare `node <guard>`. `GUARD_RE` gains an optional trailing `'?` before the
  `$` anchor so it still matches the form now written.
- `src/server/env-guard.test.ts` — one new test covering both halves together.

Why both files move at once, and why the regex change is not cosmetic: the
stale-guard cleanup eleven lines above `cmd` keys on
`/paperclip-env-guard[^\s"']*\.mjs$/`. That character class **excludes `'`** and
the pattern is `$`-anchored, so quoting `cmd` alone would stop the test matching
and pruning would silently stop working. Because the guard filename embeds a
content hash, every hash rotation would then *append* a second live `PreToolUse`
hook rather than replacing the stale one — a quieter and worse failure than the
unquoted-path bug being fixed. The `'?` branch is also what prunes pre-quoting
entries already on disk, so the first rollout does not double-register.

The unquoted form was additionally a shell-injection surface: a
`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` containing `'; touch …; '` was arbitrary command execution
inside a `PreToolUse` hook. Production session dirs are UUID-based, so this was
not reachable in practice.

No upstream change: this is Paperclip-local code under `src/server/`, not a
carried patch against an upstream adapter release.
